title: Pasco County Commission, District 4
what_it_does: County commissioners set the county budget and property-tax (millage) rate, adopt land-use and zoning rules, and oversee county services such as roads, parks, libraries, fire/EMS and utilities.
verified_ballot_note: Primary result per BallotReady/WTSP snippets; write-in opponent per Tampa Bay Beacons (https://www.tampabaybeacons.com/2026/08/12/two-republicans-square-off-in-district-4-county-commission-primary/).

candidates.name: Lisa M. Yeager
candidates.occupation: Pasco County commissioner (District 4) since 2024; former educator who worked with at-risk youth
candidates.background: Republican Lisa Yeager of New Port Richey was appointed to the District 4 seat by Gov. Ron DeSantis in May 2024 after Commissioner Gary Bradford died, and was elected in November 2024 to finish the term. She is a former educator married to state Rep. Brad Yeager. In August 2026 she won the Republican primary with 62.4% over Jonathan Deckard and faces write-in candidate Louie Rodriguez in November.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug 18 Republican primary with 62.41% (28,334) over Jonathan Deckard 37.59% (17,065) (BallotReady)

taxes.summary: In 2026 candidate questionnaires she named cutting taxes as one of her top priorities and said that during her time on the commission 'we cut taxes'. She did not describe specific service cuts.
taxes.quote: Cutting taxes, keeping our streets safe, and ensuring growth is smart and sustainable have been among my top priorities.
